wholePhysicalScope: Native modern keep footprint, Shiroishi City reconstruction figures, and the original public-domain castle exterior photograph.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the battered stone base, white timber storeys and tiered roofs.
limitations: The reconstructed keep, attached projecting roof and battered foundation. The wider park, detached gates and moat are outside scope.
Batter profiles, sash placement and small roof ornaments are estimated.
